supersedes: niftyhistory.in snapshot table (proven unreliable; see deprecated_source)
method: Anchor-and-walk reconstruction. NSE-published constituent CSVs recovered from the Internet Archive are exact anchors. On every anchor date the anchor list wins. Dates after the first anchor (2018-10-04) walk forward from the previous anchor applying dated ticker renames and NSE press-release inclusions/exclusions; each later anchor snaps the walk, so error cannot accumulate past an anchor. Dates before the first anchor fall back to the CC BY 4.0 interval table. DUMMY* placeholder scrips are excluded from the tradable universe.

primary_source.name: NSE published NIFTY 500 constituent CSVs (Internet Archive)
primary_source.role: exact membership on each capture date; overrides every other source

deprecated_source.name: niftyhistory.in NIFTY 500 snapshots
deprecated_source.why: Walk-back from the current list leaked archaic/dummy tickers into every older snapshot (e.g. VAML, VEDPOWER, DUMMYHEG present in all 50 snapshots back to 2016) and missed real members. Do not use for backtests.

caveats: 2016-01-01 .. 2018-10-03 has no independent NSE anchor; membership there is press-release derived (tier C) and carries residual uncertainty.
2018-10-04 onward is anchor-seeded and snapped at every anchor (tier A/B).
db_symbol is empty when no price series exists in universe.db; the member still counts in the index but is not tradable in a backtest.
NSE temporarily publishes DUMMY* scrips during corporate actions; they are excluded here.
sources_considered: NSE Internet Archive captures of ind_nifty500list.csv (niftyindices.com, nseindia.com, archives.nseindia.com)
